concerns.text: T058, T060, and T061 are marked as unimplemented (unchecked) yet are critical for satisfying FR-006 (sensitivity analysis on edge cases) and FR-005 (statistical robustness). The spec requires explicit handling of 'flat objects' (zero depth variance) and verification of baseline determinism. Leaving these tasks incomplete violates the requirement to produce a scientifically valid sensitivity analysis and robust statistical conclusion.

T046 (Execution Integrity Check) and T047 (Final Paired Dataset Assembly) are marked as unimplemented (unchecked). T047 is a hard dependency for T048 (Statistical Report) and T054 (Power Validation). Without these tasks, the pipeline cannot produce the 'final_paired_dataset.csv' required by FR-004 and FR-005, effectively blocking the entire analysis phase and violating the requirement to perform paired statistical tests.

T060 (Baseline Re-run Consistency Check) is unimplemented. The spec (US-2) requires re-running the baseline on 'exact same task instances' to generate a paired dataset. Without verifying the baseline's own determinism (T060), any variance in the comparison could be attributed to the baseline rather than the 2D restriction, violating the scientific validity of the paired comparison required by FR-007.

T049 (Reproducibility Archive) and T056 (Budget Compliance Report) are unimplemented. Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) require that the entire experiment state be preserved and that computational feasibility (SC-004) be measured against the 6-hour limit. Failing to generate these artifacts violates the constitutional requirement for reproducibility and feasibility verification.

T058 (Edge Case Sensitivity Analysis) is unimplemented. The spec (Edge Cases) explicitly requires handling 'flat objects' (zero depth variance) and logging specific geometric configurations. T058 is the only task addressing this specific sensitivity sweep. Its absence means the spec's requirement to 'verify robustness for this edge case' is not met, violating FR-006.
